MGRS map toolR and D areas, drawing, APP-6 symbols

On the map:

    R areas come from the Finnish eAIP, ENR 5.1 (AIRAC 004-2024). D areas come from Traficom regulation OPS M1-28, annex 1 (2023). Prohibited areas and flight plan buffer zones are left out.

    Unofficial and not for navigation. Always check the current AIP, NOTAMs and Traficom publications before you fly.

    New drawings go to the layer marked with the round button. Tick items to move, copy, delete or join them. Everything is saved in this browser only, so share or export to keep a copy.

    Affiliation
    Recently used
    Symbols

    All 1 168 APP-6D point symbols that milsymbol can draw are listed. Search works in English, and in Finnish for common symbols. You can also type any 20-digit SIDC above.

    Coordinates

    Directions

    This unit is used for showing directions. Where you type a direction (vectors, moving) you pick the unit next to the field, or add its sign: 45°, 45 30 15, 800 mil, 7-50 or 750v, 2700 MOA. Grid north follows the MGRS grid lines; it differs from true north by up to a few degrees in Finland.

    Placing things on the map

    Map

    Distances and areas are great-circle values on a sphere, good to about 0.5 %.
